source.publisher: Geoportal Berlin / Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen
source.selection: Conservative building-selection scope for pre-2001 Bezirk Mitte: unchanged complete current official Ortsteil Mitte geometry. Includes the documented 310 m² addition at Schillingbrücke effective 2008-09-28; no historical line is reconstructed or claimed survey-exact.

historical_scope.requested: Bezirk Mitte immediately before the 2001 merger (Alt-Mitte)
historical_scope.merger_effect: Former Bezirk Mitte became Ortsteil Mitte; the merger removed internal boundaries without redrawing the merged districts external boundaries.

post2001_changes.location: Southwest Spree bank immediately northwest of Schillingbrücke
post2001_changes.map_observation: Anlage 1 shows the affected embankment triangle outside the hatched building footprints; this is a visual map observation, not a modern cadastral parcel reconstruction.
post2001_changes.geometry_treatment: Retain the addition in the selection polygon as an explicit conservative allowance. The exact historical parcel geometry is not reconstructed from the raster map.

historical_scope.uncertainty: Current ALKIS precision is preserved. The 2000 cadastral boundary is not represented survey-exactly: the confirmed later 310 m² addition remains included, and later cadastral coordinate maintenance is not reversed. Do not label this file as a recovered historical survey.
historical_scope.selection_policy: Include complete building families with positive footprint intersection; do not clip their parts or surfaces to the scope line.

selection: Every complete official parent family whose ground footprint intersects the historical district by positive area; no road-distance/height filter. Whole families retained across district line. Existing authored ownership remains untouched.
